method.corpus: Fresh retained UTF-8 TXT originals and sealed revisions through LibraryApp.add_text.
method.coverage: Bounded sampled pages; an unfinished continuation is not corpus exhaustion.
method.isolation: Existing owned process boundary; fresh setup child and fresh measurement child per mode/size.
method.ranking: Thematic relevance is local to each source window, never a corpus-wide ranking.
method.rss: Whole measurement-child high-water RSS, including Python imports and source inventory; setup uses another child.
method.snapshot: Every search page revalidates the entire selected source snapshot; its cost is included.
method.temperature: First call in a new process; OS file cache is not flushed. Repeats retain that process.
method.timeout: Public search deadline and owned-child wall limit are resource bounds, not PASS thresholds.
method.timing: Library opening and sampled quote verification are separate from search_page latency.
